props.text: A professional-grade, Elementor-style visual page builder designed to embed directly into your SvelteKit applications. You own the data, auth, and infrastructure — we provide the editor canvas.
Everything you need to build a high-performance visual editing experience inside your own platform — with zero vendor lock-in.

A full drag-and-drop editing experience with canvas selection, action rails, a structure navigator, and rich inspector panels. Supports undo/redo, copy/paste, and paste-style — everything your content team expects.
Generate entire sections with Create with AI or refine existing content with semantic editing tools. Compatible with OpenAI, Gemini, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local providers.
You own the persistence, media storage, auth, dynamic data, and AI provider settings. Our SDK provides the contracts; you provide the implementation. No lock-in, ever.
Blazing fast published pages using a native Svelte runtime renderer. Editor-only code is kept completely separate from your production bundles — zero overhead for visitors.
Import native Builder JSON or Elementor JSON with full widget and layout conversion. Save selections as reusable snippets or export library items. Migrate from any platform.
Bind text, rich text, URLs, media, colors, numbers, attributes, and visibility conditions to your own data providers. Perfect for building custom CMS interfaces.

Paste raw HTML documents or fragments and watch them transform into editable Builder nodes. Extracts style blocks, scopes imported CSS, and converts containers, text, media, buttons, and links automatically.
Full autosave, draft, publish, revision history, and restore contracts — with reference SvelteKit behavior included out of the box.
Border Radius controls for containers, compact sizing/position inputs, grouped offset controls, and slider-free Z-Index editing for pixel-perfect design.
Built from the ground up as a pnpm monorepo with clear package boundaries. Each package has a single responsibility, making the system easy to understand, extend, and embed.
Project, document, node, style, media, and revision schemas
Editor engine, mutations, history, selection, persistence state
Element registry, controls, default widget definitions
Svelte editor UI, controller, import, AI, media, SDK helpers

props.markup:
# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Run the reference studio
pnpm dev

# Run checks and tests
pnpm check
pnpm test
pnpm test:e2e

# Validate embedding
pnpm embed:validate

props.text: Transitioning from other platforms? We've got you covered with a robust conversion engine that handles multiple input formats.

Convert widgets, layouts, spacing, backgrounds, borders, responsive styles, hover states, IDs, classes, and media references directly into Builder documents. Unsupported styles are preserved as scoped custom CSS with parity warnings.

Accepts full HTML documents or fragments. Extracts style blocks and inline styles, scopes imported CSS, and converts containers (<section>, <div>, <header>, <footer>, <nav>), text (h1–h6, p), media (<img>), and buttons into editable Builder nodes. Complex markup falls back safely.

Import native Builder JSON and Elementor JSON templates directly into the Globals Library. Save your current selection as a reusable snippet, save the active page as a page template, export saved items as .builder.json, and insert them back into any page.
The AI assistant supports OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoints including OpenRouter, Gemini-compatible gateways, local providers, and OpenAI-compatible proxies.
Generate semantic HTML/CSS from a natural language prompt. The output is parsed through the HTML importer and inserted as valid, editable Builder nodes.
Use safer semantic tools for targeted changes — rewrite text, improve visual style, convert selections, apply brand palettes, and more — without regenerating entire sections.

Inspect full prompts, request payload summaries, returned HTML/CSS, parsed nodes, diagnostics, tool calls, normalized arguments, and mutation summaries. All API keys stay in the host adapter — never stored in project JSON.
The builder ships host-agnostic provider definitions inspired by common CMS, site, and product fields. Real data resolution stays in your host adapter — you decide where the data lives.
Bind any text node or rich text block to your data providers.
Dynamic URLs, link titles, and any HTML attribute.
Reference uploaded media or external URLs dynamically.
Drive color values, style properties, and CSS variables.
Show or hide elements based on dynamic conditions.
Overhauled non-canvas shell areas with a dark-native visual system across Page Settings, History, Menu, and Globals for a premium editing experience.
Full-screen management for documents, presets, assignments, components, site entries, and import diagnostics — with room to breathe.
Added footer undo/redo controls and simplified redundant shell header/footer icons for a cleaner toolbar.
Expands the canvas, hides editor selection chrome, and disables preview hyperlinks to prevent accidental navigation during preview mode.
New Border Radius controls for Container and Grid Container elements, plus compact Sizing & Overflow inputs replacing range sliders.
Grouped Offset control for Top, Right, Bottom, and Left with compact slider-free Z-Index editing for pixel-perfect layouts.
Fixed dark-panel loading states, white gutters, shell tab drift, and select/dropdown readability across the editor.
Ready to Build Your Visual Editor?
Clone the repo, install dependencies, and run the reference studio in minutes. The host app owns everything — you only add the canvas.

git clone https://github.com/your-org/svelte-visual-builder
cd svelte-visual-builder
pnpm install
pnpm dev
